propositions: Recovery must classify and complete interrupted retirement operations where a binding identity exists in both tombstoned and live states.
Retirement completion removes redundant live forward/reverse pairs while preserving the tombstone only when tombstone, live forward, and live reverse entries agree on exact local_id and Jira key.
Keyed pending recovery performs no search and keyless pending recovery requires both three misses and 3600-second grace period.
Any identity mismatch, corrupt live file, or replacement failure must retain evidence and return a typed safety abort without guessing across mismatched identities.
Completion operation is idempotent — repeating completion performs no write.
The existing create-recovery invocation gate remains behaviorally unchanged, invoked only when scoped_ids is empty, with no new write-bearing or scope conditions attached.
